_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_unilateral" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_unilateral" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_days" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "day_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_day_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "block" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NULL, "rep_low" INTEGER NULL, "rep_high" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_day_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES plan_days (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "set_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rir" INTEGER NULL, "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), "logged_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "warmup_checks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "plan_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "line_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("workout_id", "plan_item_id", "line_index"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_local" TEXT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "is_recipe" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_recipe" IN (0, 1)), "kcal100" REAL NOT NULL, "protein100" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs100" REAL NOT NULL, "fat100" REAL NOT NULL, "fibre100" REAL NOT NULL, "sugar100" REAL NULL, "sat_fat100" REAL NULL, "sodium100" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "servings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recipe_food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ingredient_food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id), "grams" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id), "grams" REAL NOT NULL, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "runs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_m" REAL NOT NULL, "moving_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elapsed_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elev_gain_m" REAL NOT NULL, "avg_pace_s_per_km" REAL NOT NULL, "polyline" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_points" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "elev_m" REAL NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NOT NULL, "speed_mps" REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_steps" ("date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "splits" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "km" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elev_delta_m" REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pose" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NULL, "chest_cm" REAL NULL, "arm_cm" REAL NULL, "thigh_cm" REAL NULL, "hip_cm" REAL NULL, "neck_cm" REAL NULL, "broad_jump_cm" REAL NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_set_logs_workout ON set_logs (workout_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_set_logs_exercise ON set_logs (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_warmup_checks_workout ON warmup_checks (workout_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_logs_date ON food_logs (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_runs_started_at ON runs (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_run_points_run ON run_points (run_id)
